title: Forward exact derived-unit equation on a fixed compactification tower
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring and h:V→T, e:T→B separated finite-type quasi-compact morphisms of Noetherian schemes. Fix a compactification d of e and c of h followed by d.i. Let F and G be additive exact functors on constant-A module sheaves, with sheaf isomorphisms ah:F≅j!q* for c.restrict, ae:G≅i!s* for d, and a:F⋙G≅a!t* for d.comp c. Suppose a followed by the inclusion into (h e)* is ae followed by the inclusion into e*, then e* applied to ah followed by its inclusion into h*, then ordinary direct-image composition. Then whiskering the forward normalized units for ah and ae and composing with the canonical fixed-tower derived compact-support comparison equals the inverse exact-derived composition comparison followed by the single forward normalized unit for a. No invertibility of these units or compatibility family over other compactifications is assumed. Conventions: [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], [def-amb-etale-compact-support], [def-sfb-exact-compactification-unit], [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons].

proof.text: Use the inverse ordinary open-base-change isomorphism and take its mate along q^* ⊣ q_* and p^* ⊣ p_*. Naturality of the support inclusions and the base-change-map compatibility show that this ordinary mate, followed by the open support inclusion, is the ordinary direct-image square. Combine open-extension composition and direct-image associativity to normalize its sheaf tower map. The compactification inclusion is monic: restrict its kernel to the open and closed complement, then use that both restrictions vanish. Direct image preserves this monomorphism. Cancel the inclusion and use the hypothesis na to identify the constructed sheaf map with a.

Apply the canonical open-exchange unit normalization theorem. Its proof specializes the mixed derived-mate identity to inverse open base change, using formal symmetry of exact-derived squares. This gives the forward derived-unit normalization without choosing resolutions.

Paste the normalized mixed mate with the right-derived direct-image composition unit identity and the exact-derived open composition factorization. For the ordinary input maps ah and ae, the homotopy-category termwise identity follows from ae-naturality and cancellation of the open-composition isomorphism; prove it on complex representatives. The defining exactCompactificationUnit formula and the exact-derived composition factorization of F and G then identify the two homotopy-normalized tower paths. The sheaf-map identity from the first step identifies the final ordinary input map with a.

Precomposition with the homotopy localization Qh is fully faithful. Apply its injectivity on natural transformations to the equality of normalized components on homotopy representatives. This proves the stated equality on the entire derived category without choosing any K-injective resolutions in this module.

theorem exactCompactificationUnit_tower
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {V T B : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian V] [IsNoetherian T] [IsNoetherian B]
    (h : V ⟶ T) (e : T ⟶ B)
    [IsSeparated h] [LocallyOfFiniteType h] [QuasiCompact h]
    [IsSeparated e] [LocallyOfFiniteType e] [QuasiCompact e]
    (d : Compactification e) (c : Compactification (h ≫ d.i))
    (F : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ⥤
      Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (G : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ⥤
      Sheaf B.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [G.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
    (ah : F ≅ openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.restrict.i ⋙
      lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.restrict.g)
    (ae : G ≅ openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) d.i ⋙
      lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) d.g)
    (a : F ⋙ G ≅ openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (d.comp c).i ⋙
      lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (d.comp c).g)
    (na : ∀ M, a.hom.app M ≫ (compactificationSheafToDirectImage A (d.comp c)).app M =
      ae.hom.app (F.obj M) ≫ (compactificationSheafToDirectImage A d).app (F.obj M) ≫
        (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e).map
          (ah.hom.app M ≫ (compactificationSheafToDirectImage A c.restrict).app M) ≫
        (lowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h e).hom.app M) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (exactCompactificationUnit A c.restrict F ah) G.mapDerivedCategory ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft
        (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.restrict)
        (exactCompactificationUnit A d G ae) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationCompIso A d c).hom =
    (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso F G).inv ≫
      exactCompactificationUnit A (d.comp c) (F ⋙ G) a
